{{Top|leg}}
'''Inspire''' was a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] to fill his allies with hope and courage to face even the most terrible odds and possibly even make them slightly more resistant to injury.<ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>
